origin.description: A short string becomes one collector per letter.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.details: A short string becomes one collector per letter.
origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
s <- as.col_spec("dc")
paste(vapply(s$cols, function(col) class(col)[1], ""), collapse = ",")

translation.description: A short string becomes one collector per letter.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.details: A short string becomes one collector per letter.
translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
spec = as_col_spec("dc")
return ",".join("collector_" + collector.kind for collector in spec.cols)
